title: The calendar, and the days a team is asked on (D24, D25, D26)
description: Two clocks. The calendar runs seven days a week and belongs to everyone, and the question rotation is keyed to the team's own asked-day index. A team's working week is weekdays its manager chooses. Every window in the layer counts the team's own asked days, never calendar days.

weekdays.description: Weekday numbering, as JavaScript gives it: Sunday is 0. A port that numbers from Monday will read every schedule one day out.

schedules.description: The named working weeks. A list of weekdays may be given instead of a name. Nothing at all is refused: a team that can never be asked is not a team.

defaultStartDate.description: Day 1 of a run, read as UTC midnight. A Monday, so the default working week starts where a week starts.

defaultRollUpWeekEnds.description: D26. Where a portfolio's week ends, for the roll-up only. Three levels, each falling through to the next: a senior team's own setting, then the run default, then this. A weekday outside 0 to 6 is refused, never clamped.
